import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static long LINF = 1_000_000_000_000_000_000L;
    static final int MAX_VERTEX = 1000;
    static int[] dX = {0, 0, -1, 1};
    static int[] dY = {-1, 1, 0, 0};
    
    static List<Integer>[] edge_list = new List[MAX_VERTEX];
    static boolean[] used = new boolean[MAX_VERTEX];
    static int[] partner = new int[MAX_VERTEX];
    
    static boolean inside(int x, int y, List<String> g) {
        return (x >= 0 && y >= 0 && x < g.size() && y < g.size() && 
                g.get(x).charAt(y) != 'Y' && g.get(x).charAt(y) != 'Z');
    }
    
    static List<List<Long>> dist_grid(int sx, int sy, List<String> g) {
        int n = g.size();
        List<List<Long>> dist = new ArrayList<>();
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            List<Long> row = new ArrayList<>();
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                row.add(LINF);
            }
            dist.add(row);
        }
        Deque<int[]> q = new ArrayDeque<>();
        dist.get(sx).set(sy, 0L);
        q.add(new int[]{sx, sy});
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int[] cell = q.pollFirst();
            int x = cell[0], y = cell[1];
            for (int k = 0; k < 4; ++k) {
                int nx = x + dX[k], ny = y + dY[k];
                if (!inside(nx, ny, g) || !dist.get(nx).get(ny).equals(LINF)) continue;
                dist.get(nx).set(ny, dist.get(x).get(y) + 1);
                q.add(new int[]{nx, ny});
            }
        }
        return dist;
    }
    
    static void read_data() {
        Scanner cin = new Scanner(System.in);
        int n = cin.nextInt();
        int t = cin.nextInt();
        List<String> g1 = new ArrayList<>();
        List<String> g2 = new ArrayList<>();
        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) g1.add(cin.next());
        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) g2.add(cin.next());
        
        int rx = -1, ry = -1;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; ++j) {
                if (g1.get(i).charAt(j) == 'Z') {
                    rx = i;
                    ry = j;
                }
            }
        }
        
        List<List<Long>> d_reac = dist_grid(rx, ry, g1);
        
        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; ++j) {
                if (!inside(i, j, g1)) continue;
                List<List<Long>> d_src = dist_grid(i, j, g1);
                for (int x = 0; x < n; ++x) {
                    for (int y = 0; y < n; ++y) {
                        if (!inside(x, y, g1)) continue;
                        if (d_src.get(x).get(y) > t || d_src.get(x).get(y) > d_reac.get(x).get(y)) continue;
                        
                        boolean special = (d_src.get(x).get(y).equals(d_reac.get(x).get(y)));
                        if (special) {
                            boolean escape_possible = false;
                            for (int k = 0; k < 4; ++k) {
                                int nx = x + dX[k], ny = y + dY[k];
                                if (inside(nx, ny, g1) && d_src.get(nx).get(ny) < d_reac.get(nx).get(ny)) {
                                    escape_possible = true;
                                    break;
                                }
                            }
                            if (!escape_possible) continue;
                        }
                        
                        int cap1 = g1.get(i).charAt(j) - '0';
                        int cap2 = g2.get(x).charAt(y) - '0';
                        for (int u = 1; u <= cap1; ++u) {
                            for (int v = 1; v <= cap2; ++v) {
                                int src_id = i * 100 + j * 10 + u;
                                int dst_id = x * 100 + y * 10 + v;
                                if (edge_list[src_id] == null) {
                                    edge_list[src_id] = new ArrayList<>();
                                }
                                edge_list[src_id].add(dst_id);
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
    
    static boolean kuhn_match(int u) {
        if (used[u]) return false;
        used[u] = true;
        if (edge_list[u] != null) {
            for (int v : edge_list[u]) {
                if (partner[v] == 0 || kuhn_match(partner[v])) {
                    partner[v] = u;
                    return true;
                }
            }
        }
        return false;
    }
    
    static void run_solution() {
        read_data();
        
        int total = 0;
        for (int u = 0; u < MAX_VERTEX; ++u) {
            Arrays.fill(used, false);
            if (kuhn_match(u)) ++total;
        }
        
        System.out.println(total);
    }
    
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        System.setIn(new ByteArrayInputStream(System.in.available() > 0 ? System.in.readAllBytes() : new byte[0]));
        Scanner cin = new Scanner(System.in);
        read_data();
        
        int total = 0;
        for (int u = 0; u < MAX_VERTEX; ++u) {
            Arrays.fill(used, false);
            if (kuhn_match(u)) ++total;
        }
        
        System.out.println(total);
    }
}
